Want to build machines? You'll need motors. Coming in 4 tiers, motors are the mechanical heart of every AR multiblock. The base Motor needs a Copper Coil, Steel Plate, and Steel Rod. Advanced, Enhanced, and Elite motors require progressively better circuits and materials.

Copper Coils are the core component of every motor tier. Set up mass production of these first, they're the bottleneck for the entire motor family.

Every multiblock machine requires 1-2 motors. The Satellite Builder needs one motor of any tier. The Black Hole Generator uses Elite Motors. Motors show up everywhere from the CO2 Scrubber to the Precision Assembler.

§ePS:§f Use a Hopper chain feeding a Crafting Table with Copper Coil templates for bulk production. A single hopper setup can produce 64 coils per cycle. Don't hand-craft these, you'll need hundreds.
